Belgrade]] | highlights = | medaltemplates = }} '''Tristan Vukčević''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|Тристан Цаликис Вукчевић}}; born 11 March 2003) is a Serbian{{Cite web |title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: Serbia's Tristan Vukcevic |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-serbias-tristan-vukcevic#gid=ci02b8d55750092605&pid=getty}}{{Cite web |title=EuroLeague player profile. |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/players/tristan-vukcevic/009212/}} professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]] of the Serbian [[Basketball League of Serbia|KLS]], the [[ABA League|Adriatic League]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. ==Early life and youth career== Having been born in Italy to a Serbian father and a Swedish mother, Vukčević spent a big part of his childhood in Greece.{{Cite web |title=Tristan Vukcevic, Partizan: 'I wanted to be even better than my father' |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/tristan-vukcevic-partizan-i-wanted-to-be-even-better-than-my-father/}} His father, [[Dušan Vukčević]], is a retired Serbian professional basketball player who played for [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]], [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]], [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], Montepaschi, [[Olimpia Milano]], [[Virtus Pallacanestro Bologna|Virtus Bologna]], and others during his playing career as well as represented [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia and Montenegro national team]] internationally.{{cite web |title=Tristan Vukčević je jedan od najtalentovanijih mladih košarkaša rođenih 2003. godine. |url=https://www.kurir.rs/sport/kosarka/3237353/krv-nije-voda-jedan-od-najtalentovanijih-mladih-kosarkasa-zeli-da-igra-za-srbiju-otac-mu-je-bivsi-reprezentativac-video |website=kurir.rs |accessdate=3 September 2020}} His mother Jade (née Cicak) is a Greek-based Swedish businesswoman and former [[swimwear]] model.{{cite web |title=About Jade V. |url=https://www.jadevtales.com/about-jade-v/ |website=jadevtales.com |accessdate=3 September 2020}} ==Professional career== On 2 September 2020, Vukčević made his pre-season debut for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] in a 68–66 win over [[Real Betis Baloncesto|Coosur Real Betis]] recording 8 points.{{cite web |title=Tristan Vukcevic steals the show in debut with Real Madrid's senior team |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/1096399/tristan-vukcevic-steals-the-show-in-debut-with-real-madrids-senior-team/ |website=eurohoops.net |accessdate=3 September 2020}}{{cite web |title=68–66: Segunda victoria de la pretemporada |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/noticias/2020/09/02/68-66-segunda-victoria-de-la-pretemporada |website=realmadrid.com |accessdate=3 September 2020}} On 11 October, he made his professional debut in a 90–65 win over [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]] recording 2 points and 2 rebounds in 4 minutes.{{cite web |title=October 2020, Herbalife GC 65–90 Real Madrid |url=https://www.acb.com/partido/estadisticas/id/101280 |website=acb.com |accessdate=12 October 2020}} On 27 January 2022, Vukčević signed a multi-year contract with [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]] of the [[ABA League]].{{cite web |title=Tristan Vukčević potpisao za Partizan |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=01&dd=27&nav_id=2095857 |website=b92.net |access-date=27 January 2022}}{{cite web |title=Tristan Vukčević pens multi-year contract with Partizan NIS |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/46315/tristan-vukcevic-pens-multi-year-contract-with-partizan-nis/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=27 January 2022}} == National team career == Due to his father's background, Vukčević is eligible to represent [[Greece men's national basketball team|Greece]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina men's national basketball team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]] or [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbia]] internationally, while due to his mother's background he is eligible to represent [[Sweden men's national basketball team|Sweden]]. Also, he is eligible to represent [[Italy men's national basketball team|Italy]] or [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spain]].{{cite web |title=MAJKA ŠVEĐANKA, OTAC SA GRČKIM DRŽAVLJANSTVOM! Iz Real Madrida u REPREZENTACIJU Srbije! Kokoškov dobija veliko pojačanje |url=https://sport.blic.rs/kosarka/domaca-kosarka-i-aba/tristan-vukcevic-reprezentacija-srbije-odabir-majka-svedjanka/61m46ss |website=sport.blic.rs |accessdate=3
